entry.title: Entry #442 in SpaceX Super Intelligence LLC v. OpenAI Inc, 4:25-cv-00914
entry.summary: ORDER: The Court has no choice but to move the trial date and all pretrial deadlines in this case by 60 days. It is ORDERED that the Court's standing Scheduling Order (ECF No. 202 ) is modified as follows: The trial date shall be moved to March 15, 2027. On or before November 25, 2026, each Party must designate a lead counsel and lead local counsel for the purpose of communications with the Court. It is also worth pointing out that due to the Court's busy docket, the Parties should expect no more than three to four days for trial. (Clerk Note: See order for specific details.) (Ordered by Judge Mark Pittman on 11/17/2026) (saw) (Entered: 11/17/2026)
